summary: Implemented every stub in voluptuous/validators.py: truth, IsTrue, IsFalse, Boolean, Email, FqdnUrl, Url, IsFile, IsDir, PathExists, Maybe, Number._get_precision_scale, plus the missing _run/_exec dispatch for the sub-validator classes (Any, All, SomeOf, Union discriminant) and the _url_validation helper. The last full-suite run errored at collection (0 tests ran) because schema_builder.py still lacks raises and _compile and error.py lacks the path/msg accessors, so passed is 0 and failed is -1; an isolated harness with a stand-in schema builder passed all validator cases.
